name: howto
title: Thanksgiving week, in order
sub: From thaw to leftovers for a Thursday, November 26 dinner
footer: Sources: USDA FSIS thaw and leftovers guidance; University of Illinois Extension on thermometer placement. Dates are our arithmetic for 2026.

items.head: Sat Nov 21: start thawing
items.body: 16–20 lb bird: 4–5 days in the fridge (FSIS).

items.head: Wed Nov 25: test and prep
items.body: Ice-water check the thermometer; make gravy base.

items.head: Thu Nov 26: roast
items.body: 325°F oven; probe thigh, wing, breast to 165°F.

items.head: Thu Nov 26: serve
items.body: Hot food at 140°F or above; put leftovers away within 2 hours.

items.head: Sun Nov 29: last day
items.body: Eat or freeze leftovers by day 3–4 (FSIS: 3–4 days).
